sec.title: August 30 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 429)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 30** across American network radio and British radio comedy, four iconic episodes of *The Lone Ranger* written by Fran Striker spanning Earle Graser (1940) to Brace Beemer during wartime and postwar adventures (1943, 1944, 1954), Everett Sloane in *The Ledge* on *21st Precinct* (1956), and Angus Deayton's media parody *Good Day Sport* on *Radio Active* (1940–1982):
